row.reason: Both serve individuals seeking to exercise. Planet Fitness sells access to physical gyms through memberships, while Peloton sells exercise equipment and offers instructor-led workouts through a membership.

T:P1.6.text: Complete the Challenge by logging 300 minutes of activity in the Strava app. Once completed, you’ll earn the exclusive Planet Fitness Move Your Way digital badge! You got this!
